q: The process of recovering the audio signal from the modulated wave is known as demodulation or _____.
e: The process of recovering the audio signal from the modulated wave is known as demodulation or detection. Put transmission or emission in the gap and the sentence describes the wrong physics. Demodulation peels the audio or data back off the modulated carrier.
